prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of the old town of Tarazona, Aragon, Spain. Tourist viewpoint: the river approach, looking up at the old town. Frame: Tarazona's cathedral with its tower; the old town's hanging houses and historic quarter; the Moncayo massif on the horizon. Light and weather: clear night, gentle breeze. Main subject centered to survive a 4:5 center crop. No identifiable people, no legible logos, no text, lettering or signs anywhere in the image. Keep the lower third clean and uncluttered.
